normalization.dqmc_doubleOcc: DQMC doubleOcc has the same per-site normalization.
normalization.dqmc_kinetic: DQMC file kinetic includes both flavors and is divided by Lq, so compare kinetic * Lq.
normalization.dqmc_squareOcc: DQMC squareOcc matches this half normal-ordered same-flavor pair estimator.
normalization.dqmc_total_NE: DQMC total particle number is num_up + num_do.
normalization.ed_doubleOcc: Per-site cross-flavor onsite density <sum_i n_b,i n_c,i> / Lq.
normalization.ed_squareOcc: Per-site half normal-ordered same-flavor onsite pair 0.5 * <sum_i,s n_s,i (n_s,i - 1)> / Lq.
normalization.ed_total_NE: ED script accumulates NE = NE_b + NE_c.
normalization.ed_total_kinetic: ED kinetic operator includes both b and c hopping layers.

source: Reference values; used by the compact DQMC-to-ED normalization regression.
